vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #715 (extension round-trip conformance, Phase B); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Extension round-trip conformance fixtures and validator preservation

narratives.Description: Prove directive preserves x-consumer extension keys verbatim across a read and write, on the authority of xBRIEF v0.8 section 7. This story is independently buildable as a fixture set plus a round-trip test that does not depend on the rename or the corpus migration.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add extension fixtures under content/vbrief/conformance/extensions and a round-trip test in packages/core/src/vbrief-validate that loads each fixture, re-emits it, and asserts x-* keys are JSON-structurally equal. 2. Wire the round-trip test into the conformance gate so a dropped extension key fails the verify suite; assert the EXTENSION_KEY_PATTERN module is the single source for the namespace.
narratives.UserStory: As an xBRIEF reference consumer, I want a round-trip conformance test, so that directive provably never drops x-consumer extension keys when reading and rewriting an artifact.

items.title: Given a fixture with x-consumer keys, when round-tripped, then keys survive verbatim

narrative.Acceptance: Given a fixture carrying x-stream and x-directive keys at root, plan, and item, when it is loaded and re-emitted, then every extension key and value is structurally equal.

items.title: Given a dropped extension key, when the gate runs, then the conformance suite fails

narrative.Acceptance: Given a re-emit path that drops an x-* key, when the conformance gate runs, then it fails and names the dropped key.

items.title: Given nested extension values, when round-tripped, then inner x-* keys are preserved

narrative.Acceptance: Given an extension value that itself contains an inner x-consumer key, when round-tripped, then the nested key is preserved verbatim.

expected_outputs: extension round-trip fixtures + passing preservation test wired into the conformance gate

references.title: Issue #715: feat(vbrief): conformance fixture set + round-trip preservation in validator
